app_tagline: Understood, at work and in town
health_error: We could not reach the API. Please check your connection and try again.
not_found_body: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.
hub_sub: Pick a role. Every screen shares one live demo store, so open two tabs side by side.
hub_worker_body: No login. Open your page: shift, Skill Passport, briefing, notices, Ask.
hub_machines_body: Each link is what a Machine's QR sticker opens. Panel is the tablet beside it.
hub_foreman_body: Board, assignments, skill matrix, heatmap, briefing. Demo PIN {pin}.
hub_community_body: 自治会, city or employer posts a notice or a flyer photo. Demo PIN {pin}.
hub_senpai_body: A local helper's private link. No app, no login.
hub_reset_body: Back to the seeded shop before each run of the pitch.
rec_start: Hold the phone close and record
rec_denied: Microphone blocked. Allow it in the browser, or type instead.
rec_unsupported: This browser cannot record. Type instead.
pin_hint: Demo PINs are on the home page.
check_wrong_one: Not quite. Read it once more.
machine_not_found: This Machine does not exist. Scan the sticker again.
pick_worker_sub: First time on this phone. Tap your name once.
no_note: No instruction yet. Ask the Foreman.
passed_body: Your Sign-off is valid for 90 days, or until the instruction changes.
failed_title: Not yet. The Machine stays locked.
failed_body: Read these parts again. Your Foreman has been told which word was unclear.
panel_locked_hint: Pass the Check on your phone first.
panel_idle_hint: Scan the sticker on the Machine with your phone.
panel_software_note: Software lock only. Not a safety interlock.
skill_passport_body: Your Sign-offs. Show this to any Foreman.
near_miss_body: Something almost went wrong? Say it in your language. The Foreman reads it in Japanese.
near_miss_sent: Sent. Thank you for keeping everyone safe.
ask_title: Ask: what do I do with this?
ask_body: Answers come only from posted notices. If none covers it, your Senpai can answer.
ask_not_covered: No posted notice covers this yet.
ask_forwarded: Sent to your Senpai. Waiting for a reply.
no_senpai: No Senpai yet. Ask your Foreman.
board_sub: Who is on which Machine, what is locked and why. Updates every 5 s.
record_sub: Talk as you would to a new hire. AI writes short steps, Bengali/English, and a Check.
review_steps_body: Edit the Japanese. Glossary terms are locked to their approved translation.
back_translation_body: The translations, translated back into Japanese. If this reads wrong, the translation is wrong.
confirm_publish_body: Every Worker's Sign-off on this Machine expires. They must pass the new Check before the Panel unlocks.
note_published_body: Workers see the new version on their next scan.
skills_sub: Who is signed off on which Machine, and when it expires.
heatmap_sub: Which words trip Workers up, on which Machine.
heatmap_tip: Re-record that step more plainly, or add a pictogram.
glossary_sub: Shop words with one approved translation. The AI must use these.
briefing_sub: Say it once in Japanese. Everyone reads it in their language and answers one question.
near_misses_sub: Reported in Bengali or English, read in Japanese.
library_sub: Every approved version, with what changed. The veteran's know-how stays when they retire.
qr_sub: Print and stick one on each Machine.
senpai_admin_sub: Pair each Worker with a coworker or 自治会 senpai. Meet-ups and notice receipts feed the Support Log.
support_log: Support Log (特定技能 義務的支援)
support_log_body: CSV of meet-ups and notice receipts, ready for the quarterly report. Excel-safe.
community_sub: Photo a flyer, type, or speak in Japanese. AI makes simple steps in Bengali and English, with dates.
flyer_photo: Take or choose a flyer photo
confirm_dates_body: AI read these from the flyer. Tick each one only if it is right. Nothing is published with an unchecked date.
rrule_invalid: This repeat rule is not supported. Fix it before publishing.
notice_published: Published. Workers see it now, with reminders.
senpai_link_invalid: This link is not valid. Ask the company for a new one.
senpai_hello: {name}さん、ありがとうございます
senpai_sub: Questions from {worker} that no posted notice answers.
hub_lead: A foreman's know-how, pinned to each machine in the worker's own language. The machine unlocks only once the worker shows they understood.
reset_confirm_body: Every Check, Sign-off, notice and report made in this demo is cleared, and the seeded shop comes back.
